command:
sudo /bin/bash -c 'set -eu
id ec2-user
test -d /home/ec2-user
install -d -m 700 -o ec2-user -g ec2-user /home/ec2-user/.ssh
touch /home/ec2-user/.ssh/authorized_keys
grep -qxF '\''ssh-rsa  2026-ai-kopo-04-ssh-01'\'' /home/ec2-user/.ssh/authorized_keys || printf '\''%s\n'\'' '\''ssh-rsa  2026-ai-kopo-04-ssh-01'\'' >> /home/ec2-user/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown ec2-user:ec2-user /home/ec2-user/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /home/ec2-user/.ssh/authorized_keys
ssh-keygen -lf /home/ec2-user/.ssh/authorized_keys
/usr/sbin/sshd -t
stat -c "%U %G %a %n" /home/ec2-user/.ssh /home/ec2-user/.ssh/authorized_keys
cat /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub
'
